title: Investiture
summary: The last day of Founding Week. Jonah goes into the Flamens' house holding the genius still; on the reading glass it hides itself deeper than he ever pushed it, on its own, like something that has been on the wrong side of a glass before. First reading: clean. The cutting goes in, stupid and happy; the genius takes it from below, wears it, and the second reading says 'Grade one. Standard. Fused at nine' with the Flamen noting 'plate reads dark'. The mark is a drawing. Livia sees and files it. The collar will not open on command and is cut with jaws. Tom weeps. Priscus: 'Be precise with him. Go and be a captain.' At the engagement dinner the vigiles come; the sergeant says the word to the line and nothing happens; fangs stand near Tom and Mara; Jonah kneels and pretends to be locked, and feels a seam go. The search finds the stone box and the seal under the floorboard. Mara understands everything. Gaspar does not look up. Jonah tells his father it is a mistake, his first lie to him.

events.description: On the reading glass the genius hides itself on its own, deeper than Jonah can push it: it knows what a Flamen's glass is. First reading: no lorica, no genius, grade nothing.
events.story_timestamp: 388, last day of Founding Week, morning

events.description: The standard cutting goes into Jonah's forearm; the genius takes it from below (Devour, silent) and wears it (Shift, first mimicry). Second reading: 'Grade one. Standard cutting. Fused at nine.' The Flamen notes plate reads dark. The mark is drawn by the genius. Grade 10, Miles, hidden.
The collar does not open on the word; the Flamen cuts it with jaws, blaming old issue. Jonah is manumitted, says the citizen's oath in Latin.

Priscus lays the Republic's hand on Jonah's shoulder, with the letter in his pocket: 'Your purser is a man named Marchand, who is precise. Be precise with him.' Livia looks at the line, then at his face, says something to her brother.
Engagement dinner in Tom's two rooms: Tom's speech, Mara finishes it, Gaspar in the corner never looks at Jonah.

The vigiles arrest Jonah by the quaestor's order 'on a matter concerning the Flamens'. The sergeant says the word to the line; nothing happens. Fangs near Tom and Mara. Jonah kneels and pretends to be locked; a seam goes inside him.
The search finds the stone box in the first minute and the seal under the floorboard in the twelfth. The sergeant goes pale at the mark in the wax.
Jonah is walked up the yard road past the Flamens' house into the quaestor's house and down. He told his father it was a mistake and he would be back by morning: his first lie to Tom.

Plate darkens with grade and age; a fresh Blank cutting reads grey.

thread_beats.description: It hides on its own from the glass; it eats the cutting silently and wears it; it draws the mark; it kneels when told and does not understand why, and turns that over.
Kneeling on purpose while every piece of him wants to stand: 'a small clean tearing, like a seam going.' Integrity shown before it is named.
She watches his arm and his feet; the page does not turn when the cutting goes in; she says something to her brother after.
He performs the manumission with the letter in his pocket, jokes about Marchand, and has the rooms searched during the dinner.
The seal found under the floorboard; the sergeant goes pale at the wax.
The arrest 'on a matter concerning the Flamens' follows the letter exactly. Priscus's 'precise' is the tell.
Mara sees the word fail and understands everything he did not tell her. She does not look away. He does not look at her.
Gaspar in the corner, looking at the bottle as Jonah is taken out.

clues.description: The genius hides from the glass 'the way a man goes flat in a ditch when he hears a rifle'. It has been on the wrong side of a glass before.
clues.mechanism: The Censor hid it from the Flamens' readings for years before the derelict; it remembers the College. Ch.12.

clues.description: The Flamen: 'plate reads dark. Odd on a fresh cutting. They come up grey.' He blames Ferrum blood.
clues.mechanism: Plate colour is grade and age. Livia files it. The black-market reading in ch.38 will show it again.

clues.description: Priscus: 'Your purser is a man named Marchand, who is precise. Be precise with him.'
clues.mechanism: Priscus has read the letter; 'precise' is Marchand's word. Ch.35 Gaspar's account lets Jonah hear it again.

clues.description: Livia says something to her brother after looking at the line and his face; he nods without looking at her.
clues.mechanism: She told him the reading looked wrong. He already had the letter. Ch.34: what she said and what he did with it.

clues.description: Jonah feels 'a small clean tearing, like a seam going' when he forces the genius to kneel.
clues.mechanism: Integrity: a divided host cannot hold plate. The seam is where the plate will misfire in ch.18.

clues.description: The sergeant recognizes the mark in the wax and goes pale.
clues.mechanism: A senatorial seal, House Vibia. The sergeant knows whose house he serves.

character_emotional_states.emotional_state: Bound, in the dark under the quaestor's house. Something tore when he knelt. Lied to his father for the first time.
Pressed flat, not hungry, turning over the kneeling. Waiting to see what he does about it.
The best night of his life, then 'Son'.
Understood everything. Did not look away.
Saw something on the glass and filed it. Told her brother.
The reading came out right and he wonders why he expected it not to. The seal is on its way to his desk.

scenes.summary: Six days of holding still; Morrow explains the investiture and asks to know nothing.
The Flamens' house: two readings, the cutting eaten and worn, the mark drawn, the collar cut, the oath, Priscus's hand.
The engagement dinner; the vigiles; the word fails; he kneels; the seal is found; taken away.

opening_hook: The Flamens' house was the only building on the moon that had been built rather than cut.
closing_hook: Under his ribs the thing that knelt when he told it to is turning the not-understanding over. Waiting to see what he does about it.
notes: Grade 10 hidden under a Grade 1 mark. Jonah is now legally a Blank citizen; the collar is destroyed. The seal and the stone box are with Priscus. The Flamen of Anvil is unnamed. The sergeant carries the quaestor's token.
